integrity: The unrestricted proof is algebraic. Independent computer calculations in selected small dimensions and finite fields corroborate, but do not replace, the general proof. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Only standard model filiform Lie algebras in dimension n>=4 over finite fields of characteristic two; not arbitrary filiform deformations or odd characteristic. The formula describes ranks of all linear derivations, not rank of inner derivations. Complete literature priority is not certified; 1996 Goze--Khakimdjanov monograph was not inspected in full.
title: Characteristic-two gauge normal form and complete derivation-rank spectrum of model filiform Lie algebras
